title: Who Owns Your Toaster?
audience: Nontechnical professionals curious about building their own Agentic AI working system
message: The model supplies reasoning; your inspectable harness organizes the working system. Keep context, feedback, jobs and verification under your control.
style: Melodic electro-pop with a driving mid-tempo groove, 116 BPM target, 4/4. Warm bass, crisp drums, bright synth motif, occasional clean guitar accents. Clear relaxed lead singing, conversational melodic verses and a memorable sung chorus. No double-time rap or continuous vocal stream. Instrumental opening about 20 seconds: establish the recurring motif before any vocal, no speech or vocal ad-libs. Leave musical answers between phrases and dedicated instrumental breaks between sections. Increase energy through instruments, not syllable density. Contrasting sparse bridge, expanded final chorus, instrumental outro. Follow the supplied section order; target 2.5–3 minutes, not an exact duration.

claims.text: Analogy: models supply reasoning as electricity supplies energy; a model alone is not the whole agent.
claims.source: Hadi: Who Owns Your Toaster discussion October 7–8; analogy, not a claim of identical capabilities.

claims.text: A harness organizes context, files, jobs, rules, feedback and verification around model use.
claims.source: Hadi: Hadosh Academy agent design and Canvas production request in this conversation.

claims.text: Ownership and portability require an inspectable user-controlled harness; model swaps require compatibility checks.
claims.source: Hadi: transparency/local control principles; swap qualification is an agent-derived practical constraint.

claims.text: Jobs progress through observe, plan, execute, verify and condense, preserving useful experience.
claims.source: Hadi: explicit OPEVC production-cycle request and Academy process.

claims.text: Invite the listener to start building their working space with Hadosh Academy.
claims.source: Hadi: use this song as a Hadosh Academy marketing item.

lines.text: My files, my rules, my projects—
For the next thing we try.

notes: Revision 6 after five additional passes. Source video analyzed for structure/visual design, not copied lyrics. Instrumental and vocal sections are separate planned records; bars are targets, not audio cues. Reviewable melody-forward lyric. Ownership is a goal of the inspectable local harness. Generate Part A first if desired; stop and audition, then Extend the selected original take with Part B. No music generated or owner approvals invented.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Intro
arrangement.direction: Recurring synth motif. No vocal, spoken word or ad-libs. Reveal toaster and cable; let viewers recognize the scene.

arrangement.label: Verse 1
arrangement.direction: Relaxed melodic phrasing; two bars per short line. Toaster controls demonstrate choice.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Break 1
arrangement.direction: No vocals. Resolve the toaster demonstration; carry the motif.

arrangement.label: Chorus 1
arrangement.direction: Sung question and answer. Large type follows phrases, not every drum hit.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Turnaround
arrangement.direction: No vocals. Keep the groove and motif moving; suitable Part A extension boundary. Avoid final cadence if continuing.

arrangement.label: Verse 2
arrangement.direction: Introduce model as input and workspace as persistent structure. Build files/rules/projects as separate objects.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Break 2
arrangement.direction: No vocals. Hold the completed workspace so the idea can register.

arrangement.label: Verse 3
arrangement.direction: Show one answer, one source check and a visible approval. Calm clear delivery.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Break 3
arrangement.direction: No vocals. Verification result remains visible while music responds.

arrangement.label: Bridge
arrangement.direction: Sparse contrast. Rhythmically sung or gently spoken-sung; no rapid rap. Reveal cycle stages and saved lesson.

arrangement.label: Final Chorus
arrangement.direction: Return the same melody with fuller instrumental support, not more lyric density.

arrangement.label: Instrumental Outro
arrangement.direction: No vocals. Reprise motif, resolve cleanly. End card: Hadosh Academy, build your working space.
